text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
